title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
tldr_zh: CFM 目标 simulation-free 训练 CNF，Cond-OT 直线路径在 ImageNet 上似然/FID/NFE 全面优于 diffusion 路径
tldr_en: Conditional Flow Matching trains CNFs simulation-free; conditional-OT straight paths beat diffusion paths on ImageNet in NLL, FID and NFE.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 FM w/ OT: NLL 2.99 BPD, FID 6.35, NFE 142 vs DDPM 3.12/7.48/274 (Table 1)
ImageNet-32 FM w/ OT: NLL 3.53, FID 5.02, NFE 122 vs FM w/ Diffusion 3.54/6.37/193 (Table 1)
ImageNet-64 FM w/ OT: NLL 3.31, FID 14.45, NFE 138 vs ScoreFlow 3.36/24.95/601 (Table 1)
ImageNet-128 unconditional FM w/ OT: NLL 2.90, FID 20.9 vs PGMGAN 21.7 (Table 1 right)
FM-OT needs roughly 60% of the NFE of diffusion models to reach the same numerical error, ImageNet-32 (Sec. 6.2, Fig. 7)
ImageNet 64->256 super-resolution: FM w/ OT FID 3.4, IS 200.8, PSNR 24.7, SSIM 0.747 vs SR3 5.2/180.1/26.4/0.762 (Table 2)
